gloss: to go out, to leave, to appear

definitions.gloss: to go out, to leave, to exit
definitions.explanation: To move from inside to outside a place. The opposite of {入|はい}る (hairu).
For something to become visible or available, such as results or products.
To be present at meetings, events, or competitions.

examples.english: I leave the house at 8 o'clock.
examples.notes: Note: を particle for leaving a place

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive). Pair: {出|だ}す (transitive). Pattern: Xを{出|で}る (leave X) / Xに{出|で}る (attend X).

ASPECT: ている indicates resulting state. {出|で}ている = 'has left' or 'is out.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{家|いえ}を{出|で}る (leave home - uses を)
・{会議|かいぎ}に{出|で}る (attend a meeting - uses に)
・{結果|けっか}が{出|で}る (results come out)
・{電話|でんわ}に{出|で}る (answer the phone)

PAIR: {出|だ}す (transitive) - {本|ほん}を{出|だ}した (took out the book). Opposite: {入|はい}る (to enter).
